newsitem.title: USA: CME June volume rises 11.3 pct year-on-year.
newsitem.headline: CME June volume rises 11.3 pct year-on-year.

text.p: Volume in Chicago Mercantile Exchange futures and options totaled 20,032,967 contracts in June, up 11.3 percent from 18,004,881 contracts a year earlier, the exchange said Tuesday.
Open interest at the end of the month stood at 6,665,353 contracts, up 5.5 percent from 6,316,374 at the end of June last year.
Year-to-date volume through June totaled 111,442,202 contracts, up 8.1 percent from 103,095,250 during the same period in 1996.
Major categories and volumes were as follows:
Since January 1994 CME has counted in volume anything that creates or liquidates open positions including expired options and SIMEX mutual offset transactions cleared on the CME.
Excluding these transactions, CME "pit traded" volume for June 1997 totaled 16,708,673 and year-to-date volume totaled 99,483,261.

Beginning July 1, the CME will no longer include in its trading volume statistics certain transactions that the exchange has included since January 1994, including deliveries, option exercises, futures positions established by the exercise of options, expired options and SIMEX mutual offset transactions cleared on the CME.
